originStory.title: Why This System Exists
originStory.story: I didn't wake up one day with a perfect organization system. It evolved over **20+ years**, starting with something simple: organizing my files, movies, and comic books as a teenager. Then it grew. I applied the same thinking to code for larger and larger software projects. Then IT infrastructure. Then project management for teams. Each domain taught me something new about structure, tracking, and getting things done. Now I've applied everything I've learned to entrepreneurship, knowledge management, and life itself. This workshop is those **20+ years distilled into 90 minutes**.

creatorJourney.title: From Managing Code to Managing Life
creatorJourney.story: Over **20+ years**, I've built personal organization systems across every domain of my life. From organizing files and comic books as a teenager, to managing large-scale IT projects and infrastructure, to now balancing a half-time day job, side projects, community management, and **3 kids**. I'm **busy, but zen**. Not exhausted or lost. The system works because it evolved through real-world pressure, not theory. I'm a Knowledge Management coach and instructor, creator of the products used by thousands, and I use this exact system every day.

methodology.title: The 3-Pillar Approach
methodology.subtitle: Why Most Systems Fail (And This One Doesn't)
methodology.philosophy: Most organization systems fail because they only address ONE pillar. *GTD* is great for tasks but doesn't give you clarity on what matters. *PARA* organizes information but doesn't help you be productive. This system integrates **ALL THREE pillars** because that's what actually works in real life.

steps.title: Pillar 1: Clarity System
steps.description: From life mission to daily tasks. Goals, priorities, time horizons. **Everything aligned** so you always know what to work on and why.

steps.title: Pillar 2: Information Management
steps.description: Every piece of information has its place. Knowledge management, documents, emails, calendars, contacts. Organized so you can **find anything instantly**.

steps.title: Pillar 3: Productivity System
steps.description: Habits, routines, and techniques that work **without relying on willpower** or motivation. *Time blocking*, focus strategies, periodic reviews. The engine that turns clarity into action.

methodology.differentiation: This isn't another app or template. It's the mental framework and principles that make ANY tool work better. Use it with `Obsidian`, `Notion`, paper; whatever fits your life.

vision.title: The Bigger Picture
vision.mission: To help you escape overwhelm and live with intention. Not by working harder, but by working smarter with systems that actually fit your life.

values.title: Simplicity over complexity
values.description: Start simple, add complexity only when needed. The best system is one you'll actually use.

values.title: Progress over perfection
values.description: A good-enough system today beats a perfect system never. Iterate and improve over time.

values.title: Systems over willpower
values.description: Don't rely on motivation. Build systems that work even when you don't feel like it.

values.title: Integration over isolation
values.description: All three pillars must work together. Isolated systems eventually collapse.

vision.biggerPicture: Imagine a busy life with multiple responsibilities, but feeling **calm and in control**. Knowing exactly what matters. Nothing falling through the cracks. That's not a fantasy. It's what happens when **all three pillars work together**.
